exact_prerequisite: Construct and independently verify the full pole-free one-body residual coefficient layer after the global nested Abel transfer. The 22-atom support profile alone is not a certificate forcing.

channel_decomposition.mirror_rule: l1 is the k<->l image of k1 in the symmetric Q-row gauge
channel_decomposition.policy: Keep shift-channel labels through the first elimination so rational shift increments remain local and auditable.

letter_decomposition.rationale: Every ordinary harmonic letter has rational finite differences under n, k, and l shifts. After coefficientwise splitting, those increments reduce the correction forcing to rational/hypergeometric terms.

certificate_architecture.base: Use the reverified pole-free symmetric Q-row fluxes and their differentiated regularized products already admitted inside T3-009.
certificate_architecture.step_1: For each symmetry-reduced shift channel, express the verified one-body forcing coefficientwise in the smallest harmonic-letter block that is closed under its rational shift increments.
certificate_architecture.step_2: Solve exact rational/hypergeometric correction-flux equations for those coefficient classes; use bounded support ladders and exact modular/rational rank tests before expensive holonomic elimination.
certificate_architecture.step_3: Recombine the corrected channel/letter pieces before the final n-holonomic elimination.
certificate_architecture.step_4: Independently replay the assembled certificate, including regularized shell behavior and finite-box boundaries.

anti_oversplitting_rule: Do not require each letter or shift piece to possess its own low-order n-recurrence. Splitting is an algebraic device for constructing correction certificates; the final holonomic operator may exist only after recombination.
